QPR afirmă că Caulker, care este disponibil pentru deplasarea din Premier League de marți seară la Everton, a fost rănit după ce a căzut și a decis să nu-l pedepsească pe tânărul de 22 de ani. Rio Ferdinand și cel mai bun marcator al QPR, Charlie Austin, au făcut poze în timp ce Eduardo Vargas făcea o față duminică după-amiază, când echipa QPR sărbătorește victoria cu 2-0 împotriva Burnley. Incidentul s-a produs, conform rapoartelor, la Ship Inn din Wandsworth, Londra. Antrenorul Harry Redknapp a insistat că șansa QPR de a supraviețui în Premier League rămâne intactă, în ciuda evenimentului, care a avut loc cu doar câteva ore după ce echipa a ieșit din zona retrogradării, cu a doua victorie în trei meciuri. 'Câteva dintre jucători au mers la prânzul de duminică — era doar un grup mic. Nu i-am oprit; aveau dreptul să facă asta,' a spus Redknapp. 'Am spus mereu că nu am timp pentru fotbaliști care ies la petreceri de Crăciun — e o perioadă aglomerată. Dar acesta nu a fost o petrecere. Dacă ar fi fost, toți jucătorii ar fi mers.' 'Erau și jucători din Crystal Palace acolo, deci nu a fost un eveniment al clubului. A fost doar câțiva tipi care au decis să mănânce împreună. Steven a căzut — nu mă întrebați cum... nu eram acolo și nu pot fi cu ei 24 de ore pe zi. A căzut și s-a rănit la cap, dar e bine acum.' 'A afectat ceva? Nu, cu siguranță nu. Doar un jucător a avut o problemă — a căzut și și-a lovit capul. Restul? Nicio problemă.' 'Cu siguranță nu am crezut că merită titluri de prima pagină. Sunt cu siguranță lucruri mai importante decât Steven Caulker care se încurcă și și-a lovit capul. Ne mutăm mai departe — e terminat. Restul tipilor sunt bine și ne pregătim pentru meciul de marți împotriva Evertonului.' Caulker, fotografiat în acțiune împotriva Burnley, a suferit rănirea după ce a alunecat. Redknapp a negat și orice interes de a semna atacanții Robbie Keane sau Jermain Defoe, pe care i-a antrenat anterior la Tottenham și care joacă acum în Major League Soccer. 'Robbie e un fotbalist minunat — unul dintre cei mai profesioniști cu care am lucrat vreodată. A mers în MLS și a devenit cel mai bun jucător din ligă, nu a mers acolo în vacanță. E al lui LA Galaxy și este steaua echipei. Nu am făcut niciodată o cerere. Nu l-ar fi lăsat să plece.' 'Nu am vorbit niciodată cu Jermain. Am întrebat despre el vara trecută, dar era prea scump — și clubul nu l-ar fi lăsat să plece oricum. E un jucător excelent.'

article_content: CEOs around the world are expressing support for Israel amid its ongoing war with Hamas. Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella and Google CEO Sundar Pichai have publicly condemned the attacks on social media and issued statements to employees. 'Heartbroken by the horrific terrorist attacks on Israel and the escalating conflict,' Nadella said in a post on X. 'Our focus remains on ensuring the safety of our employees and their families.' Internally, Kathleen Hogan, Executive Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer at Microsoft, shared a message with employees stating that the company's leadership was in direct communication with local leaders in Israel. 'We have nearly 3,000 employees in Israel directly impacted. We have Jewish employees around the world who are also experiencing grief, fear, and anxiety as hatred and vitriol increase. We have Palestinian employees globally who are deeply concerned for the safety of their loved ones in the region and stand against these acts of terrorism,' Hogan said in the message. 'Thank you to the many employees in Israel volunteering to address urgent community needs and leveraging their AI, cybersecurity, data, and research expertise to help,' she wrote. Google’s Pichai sent an email to employees on Saturday, as reported by 9to5Google. 'I'm sure by now you've all seen the news of the terrible attacks on civilians in Israel and the escalated conflict now underway,' he said. 'Google has two offices and more than 2,000 employees in Israel, and it's unimaginable what they are experiencing right now.' At JPMorgan Chase, CEO Jamie Dimon issued a note to staff in Israel, telling them that the bank's employees in the region were safe as of Sunday, according to The Wall Street Journal. 'This past weekend's attack on Israel and its people, and the resulting war and bloodshed, are a terrible tragedy,' Dimon told all employees in a memo, which CNN obtained. 'We stand with our employees, their families, and the people of Israel during this time of great suffering and loss.'

article_content: On the morning of Friday, July 19, 2013, the family car and a small memorial honoring 6-year-old Alanna Gallagher were deliberately set on fire in Saginaw, Texas. Laura Gallagher, Alanna’s mother and one of three adults listed as her parents on the obituary, spoke publicly for the first time since her daughter’s murder on July 1. The arson occurred around 2:15 a.m., when a neighbor knocked on the door to alert the family. While they slept upstairs, flames consumed both the vehicle and the tribute placed near their home. Charred remains were visible in the driveway as news crews arrived. A second memorial — consisting of stuffed animals and children’s toys — located down the street was also burned. 'It’s very frightening,' Gallagher said. Police expressed dismay over the attack on grieving families. 'It’s just very disheartening that someone would do this to the family,' said Saginaw Police spokesman Officer Damon Ing. Investigators have seized more than 100 items from the Gallagher-McDaniel household and three vehicles, including red duct tape, plastic bags, and men’s belts sized 38–44, consistent with binding materials. None of the three adults — Laura Gallagher, Karl Gallagher, and Miles McDaniel — are considered prime suspects, though no one has been eliminated from the investigation. Chief Roger Macon emphasized that the family’s polyamorous relationship is not under scrutiny: 'The Gallagher/McDaniel family considers Miles as a parent, and we are being considerate of their lifestyle; it’s not our place to offer judgment on them.' Alanna’s body was discovered on July 1, bound and naked under a tarp about a mile and a half from her home. Her father did not report her missing until two hours after her body was found. The FBI has joined the case, and surveillance footage of two black cars seen near the scene has been released to the public. Neighbors described Alanna as unusually bright and mature for her age. No other children in the area have been reported missing, leaving investigators with few leads. 'I don’t want this to happen to any other family,' Gallagher pleaded. 'I just want the person caught.'

Urmele arse erau vizibile în curte când au ajuns echipajele de televiziune. article_content: For the first time, the public has seen vivid aerial images of three of America’s most secretive intelligence agencies — the National Security Agency (NSA), the National Reconnaissance Office (NRO), and the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA). The photos were taken at night by artist Trevor Paglen using a helicopter in 2013 and were recently published in the inaugural issue of The Intercept. Before these images, media outlets relied on grainy, decades-old photos of the NSA’s Fort Meade headquarters — believed to have been taken in the 1970s — despite massive expansions and billions in funding since then. Paglen’s work aims to replace symbolic secrecy with tangible visibility. The NRO, based in Chantilly, Virginia, develops and operates classified spy satellites. The NGA, headquartered in Springfield, Virginia, analyzes geospatial data and had a $4.9 billion budget in 2013 — more than double its funding from ten years prior. Paglen donated the photographs to the public domain and uploaded them to Flickr and Wikimedia Commons. His goal? To help citizens feel a sense of ownership over institutions that operate in their name — much like they do with public libraries. The revelations coincide with disclosures from Edward Snowden, which exposed the extent of U.S. surveillance. Among the most notable programs is PRISM — launched in 2007 under the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act — which collects digital communications from major tech firms including Google, Facebook, Apple, Microsoft, Yahoo, Skype, AOL, and PalTalk. The Utah Data Center, a $1.9 billion, one-million-square-foot facility near Bluffdale, Utah, is rumored to store vast amounts of intercepted data across four massive 'data halls'. Though the government remains silent on its exact purpose, it is believed to support nationwide surveillance efforts. President Obama has defended these programs as essential for national security, asserting they do not target the content of U.S. citizens’ communications. He admitted, however, that 'you can't have 100 percent security and 100 percent privacy' and pledged reforms, including changes to Section 215 metadata collection and expanded privacy protections for non-U.S. persons abroad. While corporations like Google harvest data for advertising, Obama stressed that government surveillance must meet higher ethical standards — a reminder that history has shown what happens when trust is broken.

Fotografiile au fost făcute noaptea de artistul Trevor Paglen folosind un elicopter în 2013 și au fost publicate recent în primul număr al revistei digitale The Intercept. Înainte de aceste imagini, mass-media se baza pe fotografii vechi și încețoșate ale sediului NSA din Fort Meade — crezute a fi făcute în anii 1970 — în ciuda extinderilor masive și a miliardelor de dolari investiți de-atunci. Lucrarea lui Paglen își propune să înlocuiască secretul simbolic cu vizibilitatea concretă. NRO, situat în Chantilly, Virginia, dezvoltă și operează sateliți de recunoaștere clasificați. NGA, cu sediul în Springfield, Virginia, analizează date geospațiale și avea un buget de 4,9 miliarde de dolari în 2013 — de peste două ori mai mare decât în urmă cu zece ani. Paglen a donat fotografiile în domeniul public și le-a încărcat pe Flickr și Wikimedia Commons. Scopul său? Să ajute cetățenii să simtă o senzație de posesie asupra instituțiilor care acționează în numele lor — la fel cum fac cu bibliotecile publice. Revelațiile coincid cu dezvăluirile lui Edward Snowden, care au expus extensia supravegherii americane. Printre cele mai importante programe este PRISM — lansat în 2007 în temeiul Legii pentru Supravegherea Inteligenței Străine (FISA) — care colectează comunicări digitale de la marii furnizori tehnologici precum Google, Facebook, Apple, Microsoft, Yahoo, Skype, AOL și PalTalk. Centrul de date din Utah, o instalație de 1,9 miliarde de dolari și o suprafață de un milion de picioare pătrate, situată aproape de Bluffdale, Utah, se presupune că stochează cantități enorme de date interceptate în patru 'săli de date' masive. Deși guvernul rămâne tăcut cu privire la scopul exact, se crede că sprijină eforturile de supraveghere națională. Președintele Obama a apărat aceste programe ca fiind esențiale pentru securitatea națională, afirmând că nu țintesc conținutul comunicațiilor cetățenilor americani. El a recunoscut, totuși, că 'nu poți avea 100% securitate și 100% confidențialitate' și a promis reforme, inclusiv modificări ale programului de metadate din Secțiunea 215 și protecții extinse ale confidențialității pentru persoanele non-americane din străinătate. Deși corporațiile precum Google colectează date pentru reclame, Obama a subliniat că supravegherea guvernamentală trebuie să respecte standarde etice mai ridicate — o amintire că istoria ne-a arătat ce se întâmplă când încrederea este violată.

article_content: Ben Bradlee, the legendary former editor of The Washington Post, passed away on October 21, 2014, at age 93, after receiving hospice care at home following a long battle with Alzheimer’s disease. His wife, journalist Sally Quinn, shared in a C-SPAN interview that his health had significantly declined over the two months preceding his death. Bradlee, who led The Post from 1968 to 1991, oversaw groundbreaking coverage of the Watergate scandal and the Pentagon Papers—journalistic milestones that helped bring down President Richard Nixon. Though retired, he remained connected to the newsroom, often joining former colleagues for lunch until his final months. Quinn, whom Bradlee hired in 1973 after she applied for a secretary position, was his devoted caregiver. She says he slept up to 20 hours a day and ate little, but still recognized her, held her hand, and found comfort in her presence. 'It is extremely rewarding to be there for him now,' she said. In a touching and humorous reflection, Quinn recalled a 1970s encounter between Bradlee and actress Lauren Bacall at a fireworks party in Amagansett, where the two vanished for an hour. 'I could have belted him,' she wrote, recounting her jealousy—only to be reassured when Bacall later confessed that Bradlee reminded her of her late husband, Humphrey Bogart. Their son, Quinn Bradlee, has Velo-Cardio-Facial Syndrome (VCFS), a condition affecting physical and cognitive development. The family has been open about their journey, raising awareness and advocating for those with similar challenges. In 2013, President Barack Obama awarded Bradlee the Presidential Medal of Freedom. During the ceremony, Obama joked that he was envious of Bradlee’s signature style: 'He always looks so cool in those fashion-forward shirts with white collars.' Ben Bradlee’s legacy endures as a pillar of American investigative journalism and a symbol of journalistic integrity.
translated_content: Ben Bradlee, fostul redactor legendar al Washington Post, a murit pe 21 octombrie 2014, la vârsta de 93 de ani, după ce a primit îngrijiri de tip hospice acasă, în urma unei boli lungi de Alzheimer. Soția sa, jurnalistica Sally Quinn, a împărtășit într-un interviu de pe C-SPAN că starea lui de sănătate se înrăutățise semnificativ în cele două luni care au precedat moartea sa. Bradlee, care a condus Postul între 1968 și 1991, a supravegheat acoperirea revoluționară a scandalului Watergate și a documentelor Pentagonului — momente istorice ale jurnalismului care au contribuit la demiterea președintelui Richard Nixon. Deși pensionat, rămânea conectat la redacție, participând adesea la prânzuri cu colegii săi anteriori până în ultimele sale luni. Quinn, pe care Bradlee a angajat-o în 1973 după ce a aplicat pentru un post de secretară, a fost îngrijitoarea sa devotată. Ea spunea că el dormea până la 20 de ore pe zi și mânca puțin, dar încă o recunoștea, îi ținea mâna și găsea confort în prezența ei. 'Este extrem de valoros să fiu acolo pentru el acum,' a spus ea. Într-o reflecție emoționantă și umoristică, Quinn și-a amintit de o întâlnire din anii '70 între Bradlee și actrița Lauren Bacall la o petrecere cu focuri de artificii în Amagansett, unde cei doi au dispărut timp de o oră. 'Aș fi putut să-l lovesc,' a scris ea, relatând gelozia sa—doar ca să fie liniștită când Bacall i-a mărturisit mai târziu că Bradlee i-o reamintește de soțul ei decedat, Humphrey Bogart. Fiul lor, Quinn Bradlee, suferă de sindromul Velo-Cardio-Facial (VCFS), o afecțiune care afectează dezvoltarea fizică și cognitivă. Familia a fost deschisă despre această cale, ridicând conștientizarea și promovând drepturile celor cu afecțiuni similare. În 2013, președintele Barack Obama i-a acordat lui Bradlee Medalia Prezidențială a Libertății. În timpul ceremoniei, Obama a glumit că este jalnic de stilul caracteristic al lui Bradlee: 'El arată întotdeauna atât de tare cu acele tricouri cu colțuri albe.' Eraul lui Ben Bradlee persistă ca un pilon al jurnalismului investigativ american și un simbol al integrității profesionale.

article_content: A grandmother has been charged with hiring her 19-year-old grandson to kill her husband because she was 'sick of him' and stood to inherit his money. William Strickland, 72, was shot six times while waiting for a ride to his dialysis appointment last month. His wife, Janet Strickland, 64, allegedly watched as her grandson, William Strickland Jr., shot him in the back with his own gun. After the shooting, the pair reportedly stole a wallet and other items from Mr. Strickland’s bag and went on a shopping spree, leaving him dying on the street outside their home. Prosecutors say William Jr. spent the stolen money on a new phone, gym shoes, and tattoos, while neighbors reported that Janet Strickland bought her grandson a bright red Pontiac and furniture for herself. Both are charged with first-degree murder and armed robbery and were denied bail. Janet Strickland was not present in court on Saturday because she is receiving treatment in the hospital for lung disease and high blood pressure. Assistant State’s Attorney Jacqueline Kwilos told reporters the pair discussed killing the victim on multiple occasions. '[Janet Strickland] stated numerous times to her grandson that she was sick of his grandfather and wanted him dead,' Kwilos said. 'She said she wished he wasn’t here and wanted him gone.' William Jr. had lived with his grandparents for several months after moving from Wisconsin, where he had lived with his mother and siblings, according to the family’s 84-year-old neighbor, Theolene Shears, who spoke to the Chicago Tribune.

article_content: Paul Burstow, who was dismissed in the Cabinet reshuffle, has criticized Chancellor George Osborne for allegedly trying to bury reform of elderly care. The former Social Care Minister accused the Treasury of 'bureaucratic inertia' blocking progress on a long-awaited overhaul of the social care funding system, based on proposals by economist Andrew Dilnot. Burstow told MailOnline that the Dilnot plan — which would cap individual care costs at £35,000, with the state covering expenses beyond that — had been finalized, but the Treasury refused to approve the £1.7 billion price tag. 'In the end, there is a question of political will to overcome that bureaucratic inertia,' he said. 'What kept the Dilnot proposal alive was Deputy Prime Minister Nick Clegg insisting it stay on the table, while the Treasury wanted to dump it as quickly as possible.' He added that institutional resistance has hindered social care reform for two decades — a problem he says also contributed to Labour’s failure to act when funds were available, and has slowed progress during the coalition government. Although Prime Minister David Cameron reportedly pledged to fund the plan last month, Burstow noted there was 'no sense of urgency' from the Treasury: 'There was certainly no sign of the Treasury beating a path to the door of the Department of Health.' Government insiders dismissed Burstow’s claims, with one source calling his statements 'utter nonsense' and suggesting he was out of the loop. Burstow also argued that the controversy surrounding Andrew Lansley’s NHS reforms made ministers hesitant to pursue further changes — though he noted that many leaders, including the Prime Minister and Deputy PM, had not fully grasped that the NHS changes were broadly popular. He shared receiving 'heart-rending' letters from families overwhelmed by the care system. 'I still think there is a good chance this can happen,' Burstow said. 'But the only way to make it happen now is to bring the Treasury’s role into sharp focus.' The Treasury countered that it had played a key role in reviving the issue by ensuring stable public finances necessary to fund the reform. Meanwhile, campaigners and Age UK urged the government to act, with CEO Michelle Mitchell calling the cap 'an invaluable gift of peace of mind' for older people and their families. Labour called for cross-party talks, with Shadow Care Minister Liz Kendall stating: 'All parties must come together to reach consensus on how to tackle the immediate crisis and build a fairer system for the future.' The government is reportedly considering a weaker alternative: a voluntary cap that only protects those who pay an additional fee to opt in.

Burstow a spus MailOnline că planul Dilnot — care ar limita cheltuielile individuale pentru îngrijire la 35.000 de lire sterline, cu statul acoperind costurile peste această sumă — a fost finalizat, dar Trezoreria a refuzat să aprobe cele 1,7 miliarde de lire sterline necesare. Guvernul analizează o variantă mai slabă: o limită voluntară care ar proteja doar pe cei care plătesc o taxă pentru a se înregistra.

article_content: Rescuers were searching on Friday for nearly 120 people unaccounted for after a passenger ferry sank off the east coast of Papua New Guinea, authorities said. The 238 known survivors arrived at the city of Lae via five vessels, many undergoing medical evaluations, according to Capt. Nurur Rahman, rescue coordinator with the country's National Maritime Safety Authority. Approximately 350 people were aboard the MV Rabaul Queen when it sank on Thursday, Rahman said. The ferry went down about 16 kilometers (10 miles) off Cape Fortification in the Vitiaz Strait after encountering severe conditions early Thursday. The wreck lies approximately 1,000 meters (3,280 feet) below the surface, Rahman added. Following the alert, boats and helicopters rushed to the scene to rescue dozens of people stranded at sea, facing high winds and heavy ocean swells. Joanne Meehan of the Australian Maritime Safety Authority told CNN that two Australian aircraft were assisting in the search. Australia is Papua New Guinea’s closest neighbor, excluding Indonesia, with which it shares a land border. 'I’m pleased that so many people have been rescued,' said Australian Foreign Minister Kevin Rudd. 'We’re deeply concerned about those still missing.' Rudd noted he had no information on the nationalities of those aboard. 'This is a difficult operating environment,' he said. 'We are doing everything within our power.' The MV Rabaul Queen was traveling from Kimbe on New Britain Island to Lae when it encountered trouble. 'Taking ferries is the most economical way to travel between islands and the mainland,' Rahman told CNN. 'From local media reports, many students and their parents were heading to schools that had recently reopened on the mainland.' Jurgen Ruh, CEO of Manolos Aviation Ltd. in Lae, participated in the rescue effort from a helicopter. 'I could see survivors on floating debris,' he said, adding that the ferry had fully submerged by the time he arrived. Initially, his helicopter spotted around ten life rafts, each carrying roughly ten people. But upon returning after refueling, no additional survivors were visible. Ruh suggested adverse weather likely contributed to the sinking, given the strong winds in this notoriously dangerous stretch of water. According to the U.S. State Department, Papua New Guinea had a population of 6.7 million in 2010, with about 190,000 people living in Lae. Most of the population resides in small settlements across its numerous islands. Predominantly Christian and part of the Commonwealth, Papua New Guinea recognizes Queen Elizabeth II as head of state. The State Department estimates that most of the roughly 2,000 Americans in Papua New Guinea are missionaries and their families. CNN's Elizabeth Joseph, Karen Smith, Jethro Mullen, Phil Gast, Laura Smith-Spark, and Judy Kwon contributed to this report.

Cele 238 de supraviețuitori cunoscuți au ajuns în orașul Lae prin cinci nave, mulți aflându-se sub evaluări medicale, conform Capitanului Nurur Rahman, coordonatorul de salvare al Autorității Naționale pentru Siguranța Maritimă. Aproximativ 350 de persoane erau la bordul MV Rabaul Queen când s-a scufundat joi, a spus Rahman. Nava s-a scufundat la aproximativ 16 kilometri (10 mile) de Cape Fortification în strâmtorarea Vitiaz, după ce a întâmpinat condiții severe devreme joi. Resturile navei se află la aproximativ 1.000 de metri (3.280 de picioare) sub suprafață, a adăugat Rahman. După alertă, bărci și elicoptere au ajuns rapid la locul incidentului pentru a salva zeci de persoane rămase izolate în mare, confruntându-se cu vânturi puternice și valuri înalte. Joanne Meehan din Autoritatea Australiană pentru Siguranța Maritimă a declarat pentru CNN că două avioane australiene ajutau la căutare. Australia este cel mai apropiat vecin al Papuasiei-Noua Guinee, excludând Indonezia, cu care împarte o graniță terestră. 'Sunt încântat că atât de mulți oameni au fost salvați,' a spus ministru de externe australian Kevin Rudd. 'Suntem profund îngrijorați pentru cei încă pierduți.' Rudd a menționat că nu avea informații despre naționalitățile pasagerilor de la bord. 'Aceasta este o medie de operare dificilă,' a spus el. 'Facem tot ce putem.' MV Rabaul Queen mergea de la Kimbe, pe insula New Britain, către Lae când a întâmpinat probleme. 'Luarea navelor de pasageri este cea mai economică modalitate de a călători între insule și continent,' a spus Rahman pentru CNN. 'Din rapoartele mass-media locale, mulți studenți și părinții lor călătoreau spre școli care se redeschisese recent pe continent.' Jurgen Ruh, directorul general al Manolos Aviation Ltd. din Lae, a participat la efortul de salvare dintr-un elicopter. 'Am putut vedea supraviețuitorii pe deșeuri plutitoare,' a spus el, adăugând că nava se scufundase complet până când a ajuns la locul incidentului. Inițial, elicopterul său a observat aproximativ zece baloane de salvare, fiecare transportând aproximativ zece persoane. Dar la întoarcere, după reîncărcare, nu au mai fost vizibili supraviețuitori suplimentari. Ruh a sugerat că vremea nefavorabilă a contribuit probabil la scufundare, având în vedere vânturile puternice în această zonă cunoscută ca periculoasă. Conform Departamentului de Stat al SUA, Papua Noua Guinee avea o populație de 6,7 milioane de oameni în 2010, cu aproximativ 190.000 de locuitori în Lae. Marea majoritate a populației locuiește în așezări mici în numeroasele sale insule. În mare parte creștină și membră a Commonwealthului, Papua Noua Guinee recunoaște pe regina Elisabeta a II-a ca șef de stat. Departamentul de Stat estimează că majoritatea celor aproximativ 2.000 de americani din Papua Noua Guinee sunt misiunari și familiile lor.

article_content: For nearly a year, a towering six-foot rhea has been roaming the English countryside, leaving police officers in awe — and out of breath. Last weekend, witnesses spotted the massive, flightless bird darting across a field in Brent Pelham, Hertfordshire, at speeds up to 40 miles per hour. When officers arrived, they couldn’t catch it — not because of lack of effort, but because the bird simply outpaced them. Footage shared by East Herts Rural Police shows the rhea streaking from right to left, a blur of feathers and power. This is likely Mary or Mungo — two of the three rheas that escaped from a farm in Wicken Bonhunt, Essex, back in February last year. Their cage-mate, Midge, was caught in June. While authorities have previously taken drastic action against another escaped rhea named Rita — who was later turned into sausages — the farm’s owner, Graham Fleming, is pleading for mercy. 'These birds aren’t dangerous,' he says. 'They’re more like deer. Let them live.' Rheas, native to South America and often called the 'South American ostrich,' are surprisingly well-suited to Britain’s unpredictable weather. Though males can deliver devastating kicks with six-inch claws, unprovoked attacks on humans are virtually unheard of. The RSPCA once warned the public to keep distance, noting the birds’ surprising strength and potential to target eyes with their beaks. But today, officials stress they won’t intervene unless the birds threaten traffic or public safety. In recent years, rheas have gained popularity in the UK — not just as exotic pets, but as a sustainable livestock option. Their meat is remarkably lean, with just 1% fat. And while their presence may seem surreal, these birds have adapted quietly to rural life, living for decades in the wild. For now, Mary and Mungo remain free — and the public is being asked to admire them from afar.
translated_content: De aproape un an, o rhea înaltă de șase picioare își roade țara engleză, lăsând polițiștii în uimire — și fără aer. Sâmbătă, martori au observat această pasăre masivă, nezburătoare, alergând printr-un câmp din Brent Pelham, Hertfordshire, la viteze de până la 64 km/h. Când polițiștii au ajuns, nu au putut s-o prindă — nu din cauza lipsei de efort, ci pentru că pasărea i-a depășit pur și simplu. Imaginile împărtășite de Poliția Rurală din Estul Hertfordshire arată rhea alergând de la dreapta la stânga, un vârtej de pene și putere. Este probabil Mary sau Mungo — două dintre cele trei rheae care au scăpat de pe o fermă din Wicken Bonhunt, Essex, în februarie anul trecut. Companionul lor, Midge, a fost prins în iunie. Deși autoritățile au luat anterior măsuri drastice împotriva unei alte rheae scăpate, numită Rita — care a fost ulterior transformată în salcâm — proprietarul fermei, Graham Fleming, cere milă. 'Aceste păsări nu sunt periculoase,' spune el. 'Sunt mai degrabă ca cerbi. Lăsați-le să trăiască.' Rheaele, native din America de Sud și cunoscute adesea ca 'ostricul sud-american,' se adaptează surprinzător de bine la vremea imprevizibilă din Marea Britanie. Deși masculii pot livra lovituri devastatoare cu unghiile de 15 cm, atacurile neîntrerupte asupra oamenilor sunt aproape inexistent. RSPCA a avertizat în trecut publicul să mențină distanța, subliniind puterea surprinzătoare a păsărilor și potențialul de a le ataca ochii cu ciocul. Dar astăzi, oficialii subliniază că nu vor interveni decât dacă păsările pun în pericol traficul sau siguranța publică. În ultimii ani, rheaele au câștigat popularitate în Marea Britanie — nu doar ca animale de companie exotice, ci și ca opțiune sustenabilă de creștere. Carnea lor este remarcabil de magră, având doar 1% grăsime. Iar deși prezența lor pare surreală, aceste păsări s-au adaptat liniștit vieții rurale, trăind timp de decenii în natură. Pentru acum, Mary și Mungo rămân libere — și publicului i se cere să le admire din depărtare.

article_content: With soft, fluffy manes, soulful eyes, and tiny frames, these miniature horses look like they stepped out of a fairy tale — and their presence is enough to brighten even the darkest days. Last month, Mystery and Lunar arrived at the pediatric unit of Chicago’s Rush University Medical Center, bringing smiles to children hooked up to IV poles and those too ill to leave their beds. The horses gently nuzzled patients, offering comfort, distraction, and unconditional love. About the size of large dogs, these mini-horses are part of Mane in Heaven, a nonprofit animal-assisted therapy group based in Lake in the Hills, Illinois. While therapy dogs are common in hospitals, miniature horses offer something unique: many children have never seen them before and believe they exist only in stories. Their novelty amplifies their therapeutic effect. Fourteen-year-old Elizabeth Duncan, resting in her hospital bed, reached out to stroke Mystery’s nose and said simply, 'I want one.' Seventeen-year-old Emily Pietsch, who lives with epilepsy, gently traced Lunar’s heart-shaped muzzle and added, 'They’re so nice — they don’t judge, and they’re so sweet.' Robyn Hart, director of child life services at Rush, noted the profound emotional impact these animals have: 'They bring joy, unconditional love — and for many kids, they feel like mythical creatures, as if they should have wings.' Jodie Siegel, founder of Mane in Heaven and a former obstetrics nurse, says the horses deliver 'smiles, joy, love, and laughter — and that’s true healing in action.' This was the hospital’s first-ever equine therapy visit, and monthly visits are now planned. Though some confuse them with Shetland ponies, mini-horses are leaner and more horse-like in build. Concerns about hygiene are addressed through strict protocols: volunteers carry hand sanitizer and pooper scoopers, and the horses aren’t fed before visits. During one visit, a minor accident occurred — but it was cleaned immediately, and no one was fazed. Research suggests animal-assisted therapy may reduce pain, lower blood pressure, and ease anxiety in hospitalized children. A recent review in the Southern Medical Association Journal confirmed that such therapy is safe and potentially effective. While hard evidence on reduced hospital stays is still being studied, experts like Dr. Caroline Burton of Mayo Clinic emphasize that the emotional benefits are undeniable — and worth exploring further. Guidelines from the CDC affirm that interaction with pets at home can aid recovery, supporting the integration of animal-assisted therapy into clinical settings — as long as infection control measures are followed.

article_content: A 28-year-old man from Fort Lauderdale, Marckenson Chery, is facing serious federal charges after allegedly engaging in sexually explicit video chats with a 15-year-old girl from San Francisco. According to authorities, the exchanges began on the anonymous chat platform Omegle in September before shifting to Skype, where Chery reportedly persuaded the teen to undress and masturbate while he watched — even though she repeatedly told him she was underage. Her father grew concerned in November, seized her phone, and uncovered 143 pages of graphic messages. He immediately reported the findings to local police, who coordinated with Homeland Security Investigations in South Florida. Chery, who goes by the Skype username 'Swag likeus Robinson', appeared in federal court Monday and pleaded not guilty to one count of enticing a minor. If convicted, he could spend between 10 years and life behind bars, plus face a $250,000 fine. His attorney, Joshua Fisher, declined to comment until reviewing all evidence. Joe Trias, Deputy Special Agent in Charge of HSI in South Florida, noted that predators are increasingly turning to digital platforms to target youth. 'There’s no shortage of apps out there,' he said, 'and criminals will always find ways to abuse them.' He urged parents to monitor their children’s online activity, asking: 'Would you want a 30-year-old stranger in your child’s room at 1 a.m.?'

article_content: While critics and fans alike hailed the Loki Season 2 finale as one of the MCU’s most inventive and emotionally resonant moments, it also triggered an unexpected conversation: Was this the end of Kang the Conqueror—or just the beginning? To discuss it fully, spoilers lie ahead, so pause here if you haven’t seen it—or watched Quantumania, for that matter. At its heart, the finale doesn’t kill Kang. Instead, Loki chooses a radical alternative: he becomes the new God of Stories, anchoring the multiverse within a living cosmic Yggdrasil tree. In doing so, he doesn’t defeat Kang through violence—he outsmarts him by rewriting the rules entirely. It’s a poetic, almost mythic resolution that gives Kang’s arc dignity, even as it sidesteps his physical elimination. But here’s the twist: Kang’s presence in the MCU has been surprisingly thin. Outside of Loki’s two seasons, his only major appearance was in Quantumania—a film widely panned as one of Marvel’s lowest points. And even there, the version portrayed was dispatched by a swarm of ants. Now, with both He Who Remains and the Timely variant gone, the door seems closed on Kang’s primary incarnations. So where does that leave him? Future films like Deadpool 3, Captain America: Brave New World, Thunderbolts, and Fantastic Four don’t clearly feature Kang as a central threat—and with The Avengers: The Kang Dynasty still years away (likely 2026), Marvel has ample time to pivot. Add to that the reality that Jonathan Majors is no longer working on nearly any other projects due to serious legal issues, and the temptation to quietly retire Kang becomes hard to ignore. Yet, the finale doesn’t erase Kang’s legacy. The episode explicitly reminds us that countless variants still roam the multiverse—echoing the post-credits scene of Quantumania, which unveiled the terrifying Council of Kangs. These versions remain untouched, and their existence suggests the threat isn’t over—it’s just waiting. Some believe the Loki finale was always meant to give Marvel an off-ramp: a graceful way to drop Kang without alienating audiences, especially as rumors swirl that Doctor Doom might take center stage in Secret Wars. Others argue that the story deliberately leaves the door open—intentionally ambiguous, like an inkblot test where you see what you want to see. Right now, even Marvel might not know which path they’re on. With Disney+ trimming its slate and The Marvels potentially becoming the lowest-grossing MCU film ever (despite solid reviews), the studio seems caught between narrative ambition and real-world constraints. One thing’s clear: Kang’s fate won’t be decided by plot alone—it’ll be shaped by casting realities, studio politics, and maybe even a little luck.

Pentru a discuta în detaliu, există spoileruri, așa că oprește-te aici dacă nu ai văzut episodul — sau nu ai urmărit și Quantumania. La esență, finalul nu-l ucide pe Kang. În schimb, Loki alege o alternativă radicală: devine noul Dumnezeu al Povestirilor, ancorând multiversul într-un copac cosmic viu, Yggdrasil. Astfel, nu îl învinge pe Kang prin violență — îl depășește rescriind regulile. Este o rezoluție poetică, aproape mitică, care îi acordă arcului lui Kang demnitate, chiar dacă evită eliminarea fizică a acestuia. Dar iată ce e de remarcat: prezența lui Kang în MCU a fost surprinzător de limitată. În afară de cele două sezoane ale lui Loki, singura sa apariție majoră a fost în Quantumania — un film larg criticat ca unul dintre cele mai slabe din istoria Marvel. Și chiar acolo, varianta prezentată a fost eliminată de o turmă de furnici. Acum, cu ambele variante — He Who Remains și Timely — eliminate, pare că ușa este închisă pentru principalele forme ale lui Kang. Deci unde rămâne el? Filmele viitoare precum Deadpool 3, Captain America: Brave New World, Thunderbolts și Fantastic Four nu-l prezintă clar pe Kang ca amenințare centrală — și cu The Avengers: The Kang Dynasty încă ani de zile în urmă (probabil 2026), Marvel are timp suficient pentru a schimba direcția. Adaugă la asta realitatea că Jonathan Majors nu mai lucrează pe aproape nicio altă proiect din cauza unor probleme legale grave, iar tentația de a-l elimina discret devine greu de ignorat. Totuși, finalul nu șterge moștenirea lui Kang. Episodul subliniază explicit că numeroase variante încă rătăcesc multiversul — făcând ecou scenelor de după credite din Quantumania, care dezvăluiseră teribila Consiliu a Kanglelor. Aceste variante rămân neafectate, iar existența lor sugerează că amenințarea nu s-a încheiat — doar așteaptă. Unii cred că finalele lui Loki a fost întotdeauna conceput să ofere Marvel o ieșire elegantă: o modalitate delicată de a renunța la Kang fără să alungă publicul, mai ales acum când zvonurile spun că Doctor Doom ar putea lua locul central în Secret Wars. Alții susțin că povestea lasă intenționat ușa deschisă — ambiguă, ca un test de inkblot unde vezi ceea ce vrei să vezi. În acest moment, chiar și Marvel poate să nu știe pe ce traiectorie se află. Cu Disney+ reducând portofoliul său și The Marvels posibil devenind cel mai slab film cu venituri din istoria MCU (în ciuda recensiunilor pozitive), studioul pare prins între ambiiiile narative și constrângerile reale. Un lucru e clar: soarta lui Kang nu va fi decisă doar de poveste — va fi modelată de realități de casting, politică de studio și poate chiar puțin noroc.

article_content: On August 28, 2013, CNN Student News examined pressing global and local issues relevant to students. A central focus was whether the suspected use of chemical weapons in Syria violated a declared U.S. 'red line,' sparking discussion about possible military strikes—and whether diplomatic efforts, sanctions, or international investigations might offer better solutions. In Chicago, the 'Safe Passage' initiative was highlighted as a community-driven effort to keep students safe on their way to school, involving trained volunteers, improved street lighting, and safer walking routes. In California, officials raised alarms that an ongoing wildfire threatened the quality and availability of San Francisco’s water supply. To commemorate the 50th anniversary of the historic 1963 March on Washington for Jobs and Freedom, the segment shared five key facts: the event’s full name, its date, its dual goals of racial equality and economic opportunity, and the leadership of figures like Congressman John Lewis, who was then a 23-year-old activist and later became a revered civil rights icon. The broadcast also directed viewers to supplementary materials—including a transcript, educational maps of Syria and Washington, D.C., a standards-aligned curriculum, and reflective questions designed to deepen media literacy and historical understanding.

article_content: CNN) — To the naked eye, it may appear as a blur: a frenzied whirlwind of arms and legs. But for ancient Greece, the discus throw epitomized an intoxicating marriage of harmony and balance. With a heritage stretching back to the fifth century BC, Melina Robert-Michon is almost evangelical in her desire for the world to rediscover the art and beauty of the discus. For over a decade, the 34-year-old has stood alone as France’s leading exponent of a discipline descended from Discobolus — the iconic figure in Myron’s famous sculpture of a discus thrower from around 450 BC. 'It's a sport that always existed; we all have the image of the Greek statues from Discobolus,' Robert-Michon told CNN’s Human to Hero series. 'But our goal is to show that this sport has evolved — it’s interesting to practice and to watch, and we need to promote it. Promotion is the best way to discover or rediscover its modern form.' The complexity of the throwing technique — the very element that hooked Robert-Michon as a teenager — remains as mysterious as ever: a juxtaposition of intensity, power, and calm. Beyond advocating for the sport’s technical nuances, Robert-Michon is equally committed to dismantling outdated perceptions of female discus throwers as bulky or masculine. 'The image of women in discus has changed over the years,' said the French athlete, who finished fifth at the London Olympics — her fourth consecutive Games appearance. 'We are no longer stereotyped as bodybuilder-shaped women. Today, we have very feminine physiques, not drastically different from the norm — and that’s really important. There’s been real evolution. For me, there are no difficulties left in this regard.' A latecomer to the sport, Robert-Michon switched from handball — via the shot put — at age 16, following a recommendation from her high school sports teacher. Drawn in by the mystery of the technique, which she mastered remarkably quickly, she placed second at the World Junior Championships three years later and became European U23 champion the following season. Between those achievements, she competed in her first Olympics in Sydney 2000, then again in Athens 2004, where the Games returned to their birthplace. International success has been inconsistent, but she has dominated domestically. Her French record throw of 65.78 meters has stood for over a decade; since 2000, she has won the national title every year except 2010, when she took a break to have a baby. 'When I started, what I loved most was the difficulty of throwing,' said Robert-Michon, who was born in Isère in the French Alps. 'I didn’t understand how someone could hurl such a heavy object with such speed, perfect trajectory, and a flat spin. That mystery fascinated me — it’s what drove me to master it. The technique is both technical and physical. You must improve physically without sacrificing technique; when you adjust your form, you can’t lose your strength — you must maintain balance. You can be stronger, but if you can’t channel that power into the motion, it’s useless.' With success often decided by mere centimeters, every element must align perfectly. 'The qualities of a discus thrower are explosiveness, dynamism, and speed — all while remaining extremely relaxed,' she added. 'The goal is to move fast but extend the time of release — it’s paradoxical, and that’s what makes it hard. You need relaxed arms, giving the discus maximum time before release. The goal is to feel the discus in your hand — I can’t fully explain it — but I feel as if it belongs to my body, as if it’s an extension of my hands.' Few could dispute Robert-Michon’s four Olympic appearances given her unwavering dedication. She trains up to 30 hours a week, often alone, as her coach, Serge Debie, must accommodate training around his other commitments — frequently during winter months when competitions are absent. The precarious reality of her career meant she worked and studied until turning professional in 2008, even serving briefly in the army’s communications department in 2004. She continues to visit schools to share her story and champion her sport. 'My ambition is to promote discus so people know it — and learn to love it. You can’t love something you don’t know,' she said. 'I’ve seen people follow my results, discover discus through me, and suddenly become fans — or even start throwing themselves. Sport has given me so much. When I go to schools, I want to pass that on. I want to tell kids they can achieve things. Athletics is powerful because it welcomes every body type. Everyone can find their own sport and enjoy it. I’ve learned so much from athletics and discus — and I want to share what I’ve gained.'
translated_content: CNN) — Pentru ochiul uman, poate părea o încețoșare: un vârtej frenetic de brațe și picioare. Dar pentru Grecia antică, aruncarea discului a simbolizat o căsătorie înfocată de armonie și echilibru. Cu o moștenire care se întinde înapoi până în secolul al V-lea î.Hr., Melina Robert-Michon este aproape evanghelică în dorința ei ca lumea să redescopere arta și frumusețea aruncării discului. De peste un deceniu, femeia de 34 de ani stă singură ca principalul reprezentant al Franței într-o disciplină descendentă de Discobolul — figura iconică din sculptura celebră a lui Myron, reprezentând un aruncător de disc din jurul anului 450 î.Hr. 'Este un sport care a existat întotdeauna; avem toți imaginea statuilor grecești din Discobolul,' a spus Robert-Michon pentru seria CNN Human to Hero. 'Dar scopul nostru este să arătăm că acest sport s-a schimbat — este interesant de practicat și de urmărit, și trebuie să-l promovăm. Promovarea este cel mai bun mod de a descoperi sau rediscovered forma sa modernă.' Complexitatea tehnicii de aruncare — elementul care o-a prins pe Robert-Michon când era adolescentă — rămâne la fel de misterioasă ca întotdeauna: o juxtapunere de intensitate, putere și liniște. În afară de a propovădui detalii tehnice ale sportului, Robert-Michon este la fel de hotărâtă să depășească percepțiile învechite despre aruncătoarele de disc feminin ca fiind masive și masculinizate. 'Imaginea femeilor în aruncarea discului s-a schimbat în ultimii ani,' a spus atleta franceză, care a terminat pe locul cinci la Jocurile Olimpice de la Londra — a patra apariție consecutivă la Jocuri. 'Nu mai suntem stereotipate ca femei cu corpuri de culturism. Acum avem corporaturi foarte feminine, nu foarte diferite de normă — și asta e foarte important. A avut loc o evoluție reală. Pentru mine, nu există dificultăți în această privință.' O venită târziu în sport, Robert-Michon a trecut de la handbal — prin aruncarea greutății — la vârsta de 16 ani, la recomandarea profesorului ei de educație fizică din liceu. Atrasă de misterul tehnicii de aruncare, pe care a dominat-o într-un timp record, a obținut locul doi la Campionatele Mondiale Junioare trei ani mai târziu și a devenit campioană europeană sub 23 de ani în sezonul următor. Între aceste două succese, femeia franceză a participat pentru prima dată la Jocurile Olimpice, la Sydney în 2000, continuând apoi la Atena patru ani mai târziu, unde Jocurile au avut o întoarcere emoțională la locul nașterii lor. Succesul pe scena internațională a fost intermitent, dar ea a dominat pe terenul propriu. Recordul francez al ei de 65,78 metri a rezistat peste un deceniu și, din 2000, nu a câștigat titlul național decât o dată — în 2010, când a luat o pauză din sport pentru a avea un copil. 'Când am început, ce mi-a plăcut cel mai mult a fost dificultatea aruncării,' a spus Robert-Michon, născută în Isère, în Alpii francezi. 'Nu înțelegeam cum se putea arunca un astfel de obiect greu cu atât de multă viteză, traiectorie perfectă și o rotație plană. Acest mister m-a fascinat — asta m-a împins să-l domin. Tehnica este atât tehnică, cât și fizică. Trebuie să progresezi fizic fără să sacrifici tehnica; când faci o schimbare tehnică, nu poți pierde fizicul — trebuie să menții echilibrul. Poți fi mai puternică, dar dacă nu poți transmite această putere în motor și tehnica, forța fizică e inutilă.' Cu succesul și eșecul adesea decis de câțiva centimetri, toate aceste elemente trebuie combinate la perfecție. 'Calitățile unui aruncător de disc sunt explozivitatea, dinamismul și viteza — toate în timp ce rămâi extrem de relaxată,' a adăugat ea. 'Scopul este să mergi repede, dar să dai discului timpul cel mai lung posibil înainte de eliberare — e paradoxal — dar asta face sportul dificil. Scopul este să ai brațele foarte relaxate, să dai discului mult timp înainte de aruncare. Scopul este să simți bine discul în mână — nu știu cum să descriu asta — să ai un disc care se potrivește cu mâna mea. Am senzația că aparține corpului meu, mâinilor mele.' Puțini ar putea contesta cele patru apariții ale lui Robert-Michon la cea mai mare scenă sportivă, având în vedere determinarea fără egal pe care a arătat-o față de meseria sa. Cele 30 de ore pe săptămână pe care le petrece antrenându-se sunt adesea singură, antrenorul ei Serge Debie trebuind să încadreze antrenamentele în jurul altor angajamente, și efectuate în adâncimea iernii, când nu există competiții. Astfel de este existența precară a unui aruncător de disc, încât Robert-Michon a continuat să lucreze și să studieze până a devenit profesionistă în 2008, chiar și făcând o scurtă perioadă în departamentul de comunicații al armatei în 2004. Ea continuă să viziteze școli pentru a vorbi despre viața ei ca atletă și este disperată să răspândească cuvântul despre disciplina sa aleasă. 'Ambiția mea este să promovez sportul meu, astfel încât oamenii să-l cunoască și să-l iubească. Nu poți să-l iubești dacă nu-l cunoști,' a spus ea. 'Îmi dau seama că oamenii care urmăresc rezultatele mele și încep să se intereseze de aruncarea discului doar pentru că mă cunosc, de fapt încep să-l iubească și să-l urmărească sau chiar să-l practice. Sportul mi-a adus mult și când merg la școli, scopul meu este să-l transmit și să împărtășesc ce mi-a adus. Vreau să le spun că pot face lucruri. Atletismul este grozav pentru că poate fi practicat de orice tip de corp sau model, toată lumea poate alege propriul sport și să-l aprecieze. Am învățat mult din sport și aruncarea discului, și vreau să împărtășesc ce am primit.'

article_content: Following a chaotic and contentious European Grand Prix in Valencia, the Williams Formula One team is urging officials to overhaul the safety-car regulations—not just clarify them. Nine drivers were penalized after the race for exceeding speed limits while the safety car was deployed, triggered by a terrifying crash involving Red Bull’s Mark Webber, who escaped without injury. Williams driver Rubens Barrichello was handed a five-second time penalty despite finishing fourth, prompting team technical director Sam Michael to question the logic behind the rules. 'We don’t need more clarification—we need a rethink,' Michael said. While he admits he once preferred the old system that allowed pit stops under the safety car for tactical gain, he now recognizes the priority must be driver safety. Meanwhile, Ferrari president Luca di Montezemolo labeled the race 'unacceptable,' arguing that teams who followed the rules were punished more harshly than those who broke them. Lewis Hamilton, the championship leader, overtook the safety car illegally but was only penalized after the checkered flag, allowing him to keep second place and secure 18 crucial points. His rival Fernando Alonso, who finished eighth, criticized the delay in issuing the penalty, calling it unjust and poorly timed. Similar confusion marred the Canadian Grand Prix when Michael Schumacher passed Alonso under the safety car on the final lap—resulting in a 20-second penalty that dropped him from sixth to twelfth. Although the FIA later clarified that overtaking under the safety car on the final lap is banned, the repeated inconsistencies have fueled growing frustration. Montezemolo warned that if the governing body doesn’t act decisively, Formula One risks losing public trust. 'Those who obeyed the rules paid the highest price,' he said. 'Those who didn’t? They got off easy. That’s not just unfair—it’s dangerous.'
translated_content: În urma unui Mareșal European controversat și haotic din Valencia, echipa Williams de Formula 1 îndeamnă oficialii să reevalueze regulile privind mașina de siguranță—nu doar să le clarifice. Nouă piloți au primit pedepse după cursă pentru depășirea limitelor de viteză în timp ce mașina de siguranță era activă, după un accident teribil care a implicat Mark Webber din Red Bull, care a scăpat fără leziuni. Pilotul Williams Rubens Barrichello a primit o pedeapsă de cinci secunde, deși a terminat pe locul patru, ceea ce l-a determinat pe șeful tehnic al echipei, Sam Michael, să pună la îndoială logica regulilor. 'Nu avem nevoie de mai multe clarificări—avem nevoie de o reevaluare totală,' a spus Michael. Deși recunoaște că în trecut a preferat vechiul sistem care permitea oprirea în boxe sub mașina de siguranță pentru avantaj tactic, el recunoaște acum că prioritatea trebuie să fie siguranța pilotului. Între timp, președintele Ferrari, Luca di Montezemolo, a etichetat cursa ca fiind 'inacceptabilă', susținând că echipele care au respectat regulile au fost pedepsite mai sever decât cele care le-au încălcat. Lewis Hamilton, liderul campionatului, a depășit ilegal mașina de siguranță, dar a primit pedeapsa abia după finalul cursei, permițându-i să păstreze locul doi și să obțină 18 puncte esențiale. Rivalul său Fernando Alonso, care a terminat pe locul opt, a criticat întârzierea acordării pedepsei, numind-o nescoreată și greșit temporizată. O confuzie similară a marcat Mareșalul Canadei, când Michael Schumacher a depășit pe Alonso sub mașina de siguranță în ultima tură—rezultând într-o pedeapsă de 20 de secunde care l-a coborât de pe locul șase pe locul doisprezece. Deși FIA a încercat ulterior să clarifice că depășirea mașinii de siguranță în ultima tură este interzisă, inconsistentele repetate au alimentat frustrarea crescută. Montezemolo a avertizat că, dacă organismul de conducere nu acționează hotărât, Formula 1 riscă să piardă încrederea publicului. 'Cei care au respectat regulile au plătit cel mai mare preț,' a spus el. 'Cei care nu au făcut asta? Au ieșit cu ușurință. Nu e doar incorect—e periculos.' article_content: A mass grave containing 230 bodies has been uncovered in Deir el-Zour, Syria, after Islamic State (ISIS) militants are believed to have executed members of the Shaitaat tribe, who had resisted their rule. Relatives of the victims, from the Shaitaat tribe, discovered the burial site in eastern Deir el-Zour province, according to the Britain-based Syrian Observatory for Human Rights (SOHR). The grim discovery raises the estimated death toll of Shaitaat tribe members during ISIS’s summer offensive in the region to more than 900, SOHR reported. The province borders Iraq and contains critical oilfields that have funded ISIS operations. 'The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights has learned from trusted sources that more than 230 bodies have been found in a mass grave in the desert near Al-Kashkiyeh in eastern Deir el-Zour,' the group said. It added that the vast majority of the deceased were civilians, many executed in cold blood after the tribe rose up against ISIS—having previously driven out rival jihadist and rebel groups from the area. Hundreds more members of the Shaitaat tribe—whose population is estimated at around 70,000—are still missing, according to SOHR, which relies on a network of activists, doctors, and military sources across all sides of the Syrian conflict. Under ISIS ideology, armed resistance is deemed heresy and punishable by death. Tribespeople returned to their villages only after agreeing to abide by strict ISIS-imposed conditions: a curfew, a ban on gatherings, and surrender of weapons. ISIS controls nearly all of Deir el-Zour province, including areas adjacent to its holdings in Iraq. Although U.S.-led airstrikes began targeting ISIS in Syria in September, the group continues to operate, including fighting Syrian government forces near Deir el-Zour city for control of a key military airbase—one of the regime’s last eastern strongholds. In August, activists reported that ISIS killed approximately 700 Shaitaat tribe members—mostly civilians—over a two-week period following clashes over two oilfields. SOHR confirmed that beheadings were commonly used in these executions.

Relativii victimelor, din tribul Shaitaat, au descoperit situl de înhumare în provincia Deir el-Zour, estică, conform Observatorului Sirian pentru Drepturile Omului (OSDO), o organizație bazată în Marea Britanie. Descoperirea tristă ridică numărul estimat de morți din tribul Shaitaat în timpul ofensivei de vară a ISIS în regiune la peste 900, a raportat OSDO. Provincia este vecină cu Irakul și conține câmpuri de petrol critice care au finanțat operațiunile ISIS. 'Observatorul Sirian pentru Drepturile Omului a aflat de la surse de încredere că peste 230 de corpuri au fost găsite într-o groapă comună în deșertul din apropierea localității Al-Kashkiyeh, în estul Deir el-Zour,' a spus grupul. A adăugat că majoritatea victimelor erau civili, mulți executați în mod rău intenționat după ce tribul s-a ridicat împotriva ISIS—după ce anterior îi expulzase pe rivalii jihadiști și rebelii din zonă. Sute de membri suplimentari ai tribului Shaitaat—al cărui număr este estimat la aproximativ 70.000—sunt încă dispăruți, conform OSDO, care se bazează pe o rețea de activiști, medici și surse militare din toate părțile conflictului sirian. Conform ideologiei ISIS, rezistența armată este considerată erezie și pedepsită cu moartea. Tribenii s-au întors în satele lor doar după ce au acceptat condițiile stricte impuse de ISIS: un tocur, interdicția asupra adunărilor și predarea armelor. ISIS controlează aproape întreaga provincie Deir el-Zour, inclusiv zonele adiacente teritoriilor sale din Irak. Deși atacurile aeriene conduse de SUA au început să țintească ISIS în Siria în septembrie, grupul continuă să opereze, luptând forțele guvernamentale siriene în apropierea orașului Deir el-Zour pentru controlul unei baze aeriene militare cheie—una dintre ultimele poziții ale regimului în estul țării. În august, activiștii au raportat că ISIS a ucis aproximativ 700 de membri ai tribului Shaitaat—în mare parte civili—în decurs de două săptămâni, urmând confruntări legate de două câmpuri de petrol. OSDO a confirmat că decapitările au fost folosite frecvent în aceste execuții.

article_content: Zolgensma, a groundbreaking one-time gene therapy for spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) in children under two, costs approximately ₹17 crore per dose in India — making it one of the world’s most expensive drugs. Although not officially approved in India, it can be imported with a doctor’s recommendation and government clearance. Developed by Swiss pharmaceutical giant Novartis, Zolgensma delivers a functional copy of the SMN gene to motor neuron cells, helping restore muscle function in SMA patients. According to Dr. N. Varsha Monica Reddy, a pediatric neurologist at Yashoda Hospitals in Hyderabad, the therapy addresses the root cause of SMA: insufficient production of the SMN protein, which leads to progressive muscle weakness and often early death. The drug’s exorbitant price stems largely from the immense research and development costs, compounded by a very small patient population. As Dr. Vibhu Kawatra, a pediatrician at Rainbow Children’s Hospital in Delhi, explained to PTI, while the upfront cost is staggering, long-term savings on lifelong SMA care may justify the investment. Novartis CEO Vas Narasimhan acknowledged the ethical challenge: how to price a therapy that offers lifelong benefits with just one dose. Globally, over 2,500 patients have received Zolgensma, and Novartis has provided nearly 300 free doses to children in 36 countries through charitable programs. The issue gained renewed attention after Karnataka Chief Minister Siddaramaiah wrote to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, requesting support to fund treatment for a 15-month-old SMA patient. Zolgensma is approved in 45 countries, including the U.S., EU nations, and Japan, but access remains limited in low- and middle-income regions like India.

Deși nu este oficial aprobat în India, poate fi importat cu recomandarea unui medic și aprobarea autorităților guvernamentale. Varsha Monica Reddy, neurolog pediatric la spitalul Yashoda din Hyderabad, terapia abordează cauza fundamentală a SMA: producția insuficientă a proteinei SMN, care duce la slăbiciune musculară progresivă și adesea la moarte prematură. Prețul exorbitant al medicamentului provine în mare parte din costurile imense de cercetare și dezvoltare, combinate cu o populație de pacienți foarte mică. După cum a explicat dr. Vibhu Kawatra, pediatru la Rainbow Children’s Hospital din Delhi, PTI, deși costul inițial este șocant, economiile pe termen lung legate de îngrijirea continuă a SMA pot justifica investiția. CEO-ul Novartis, Vas Narasimhan, a recunoscut provocarea etică: cum să se stabilească un preț pentru o terapie care oferă beneficii pe tot parcursul vieții cu o singură doză. article_content: Two young boys burst into tears when they saw their family’s cat, Madison, for the first time in over two months—after she was presumed lost. In a heartwarming YouTube video, their mother, Sheryl, instructed the three children sitting on the couch to cover their faces with pillows and blankets until she gave the signal. As suspense built, the children giggled and shrieked in anticipation. When Sheryl finally said, 'Okay, you can look,' the children removed their coverings and erupted in joyful shouts. There, held by their 18-year-old sister, was Madison—their beloved, one-eyed feline. 'I knew it! I knew it!' yelled the blond-haired 11-year-old, rushing toward the cat and wrapping his arms around her in a tearful embrace. His younger brother and sister quickly followed suit. One of the boys, identified as Shane, asked where Madison had been found. Sheryl replied, 'She was down by the Shell gas station. I found her today.' Shane, visibly overcome, wiped tears from his reddened eyes and whispered, 'I’m so happy.' Sheryl explained that Madison, now 13 years old, had slipped out two months earlier—likely aided by the family’s other cat, who knows how to open the patio screen. On the day she was found, Sheryl spotted the cat near some children, rolling on the ground in her signature move—a gesture only Madison would make. 'It was her!' she recalled. She immediately called her 18-year-old daughter, who met her at home with tears in her eyes. Sheryl then arranged the surprise reunion, asking her daughter to wait with Madison in her room while she fetched the boys from school. In a follow-up statement to Rumble, Sheryl shared that Madison was adopted as a tiny kitten, requiring bottle-feedings and constant companionship. She has always loved perching on people’s shoulders. The boys, who’ve known her their entire lives, consider her family. The video captures not just a reunion, but the enduring bond between a pet and the children who grew up with her.

Într-un videoclip emoționant postat pe YouTube, mama lor, Sheryl, le-a cerut celor trei copii care stăteau pe un canapea să-și acopere fețele cu perne și plăpumi până când le-a dat semnalul. Pe măsură ce tensiunea creștea, copiii râdeau și strigau de anticipare. Acolo, ținută de sora lor de 18 ani, era Madison—pisica lor iubită, cu un singur ochi. 'Știam! Știam!' a strigat băiatul blond de 11 ani, alergând spre pisică și îmbrățișând-o într-o îmbrățișare plină de lacrimi. Fratele lui mai mic și sora sa l-au urmat imediat. Unul dintre băieți, identificat ca Shane, a întrebat unde a fost găsită Madison. Sheryl a răspuns: 'A fost la stația de benzină Shell. Am găsit-o astăzi.' Shane, vizibil emoționat, ștergea lacrimile de pe ochii și nasul roșii și a murmurat: 'Sunt atât de fericit.' Sheryl a explicat că Madison, acum de 13 ani, a scăpat acum două luni—probabil ajutată de cealaltă pisică a familiei, care știe să deschidă geamul de pe terasă. În ziua în care a fost găsită, Sheryl a observat-o în apropierea unor copii, răsucindu-se pe pământ în mișcarea ei caracteristică—un gest pe care doar Madison îl făcea. 'Era ea!' și-a amintit ea. A sunat imediat sora ei de 18 ani, care a venit la ușă cu lacrimi în ochi. Sheryl a cerut apoi să o aștepte pe sora ei cu Madison în cameră, în timp ce ea mergea să-i aducă pe băieți de la școală. Într-o declarație ulterioară făcută pe Rumble, Sheryl a spus că Madison a fost adoptată ca un pui mic, necesitând hrănire cu sticlă și însoțire constantă. Ea a iubit întotdeauna să stea pe umerii oamenilor. Băieții, care o cunosc de totdeauna, o consideră parte din familie. Videoclipul capturează nu doar o reîntâlnire, ci și legătura durabilă dintre o pisică și copiii care au crescut alături de ea.

article_content: Four adult men have been arrested after allegedly sexually assaulting two underage girls, filming the assault, and uploading the video to the internet. The footage was discovered by a teacher at a middle school in Portland, Oregon, who recognized one of the girls as a student at Centennial Middle School and immediately alerted authorities. The video, reportedly recorded on May 19, 2013, spread across social media within the school district, eventually appearing on a student’s Facebook page. A socially aware educator noticed the girl and reported the incident to the school principal. Authorities quickly identified the suspects: Cedrell Washington, 20; Deshawn Rogers, 22; Nicholas Clisby, 23; and Terry Scott, 18. All four face multiple felony charges, including rape and endangering the welfare of a minor. One suspect is affiliated with the Unthank Park Hustlers gang. Portland Police Captain Kevin Modica, who leads the Multnomah County Child Abuse Team, called the crime 'extremely outrageous' and expressed deep distress that such an act occurred in the community. 'The victims may never recover from this,' he said. Dr. Jack Levin, a criminology professor and co-director of Northeastern University’s Brudnick Center on Violence and Conflict, condemned the suspects’ decision to post the video online. 'The illusion of anonymity online is a dangerous delusion,' he stated. 'The line between public and private has been erased by the internet.' The 12-year-old victim has been advised not to return to school for the remainder of the academic year due to widespread exposure of the video among peers. However, Principal Doug Cook confirmed that the school remains in close contact with the girl and her family, offering ongoing support. He emphasized that the school welcomes her return if she chooses to come back.

Videoclipul, înregistrat presumibil pe 19 mai 2013, s-a răspândit pe rețelele sociale în cadrul districtului școlar, ajungând în cele din urmă pe pagina de Facebook a unui elev. article_content: Catherine, Duchess of Cambridge, made her final solo public appearance before the birth of her child by naming the Royal Princess cruise ship off England’s south coast. Wearing a chic black-and-white animal-print coat, she performed the traditional ceremony of cutting a ribbon to smash a bottle of champagne against the ship’s hull in Southampton. The event, attended by charity representatives and dignitaries, featured a blessing from the Bishop of Winchester, Tim Dakin; a performance by British pop star Natasha Bedingfield; and music from military bands. Following the ceremony, Catherine was given a brief tour of the vessel as its official godmother. Owned by Princess Cruises — a subsidiary of Carnival Corp. — the Royal Princess can accommodate 3,600 passengers and boasts the largest pastry shop at sea. Its maiden voyage begins Sunday, followed by Mediterranean cruises this summer and Eastern Caribbean itineraries in autumn. Built at the Fincantieri shipyard in Monfalcone, Italy, the ship honors its British roots. Alan Buckelew, President and CEO of Princess Cruises, highlighted its lineage back to the historic P&O Steam Navigation Company. Notably, Prince William’s mother, Princess Diana, served as godmother to the original Royal Princess when it launched in 1984 — and both women recited the exact same words during their ceremonies: 'I name this ship Royal Princess. May God bless her and all who sail in her.' Other notable royal godmothers include former UK Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher and icons Audrey Hepburn and Sophia Loren. Though the sex of the royal baby remains unknown, changes to the line of succession mean the child will become heir to the British throne regardless of gender. Catherine and Prince William were married at Westminster Abbey in April 2011. William is second in line after his father, Prince Charles. Meanwhile, Queen Elizabeth II recently marked 60 years since her coronation. On Monday, she visited her husband, Prince Philip, at the hospital, where he continues to recover from abdominal surgery. The 92-year-old Duke of Edinburgh may remain hospitalized for another week, according to the Palace.

article_content: By Steve Nolan. PUBLISHED: 10:50 EST, 24 February 2013. | UPDATED: 10:56 EST, 24 February 2013. Apology: David Crompton has issued an apology after sending an 'inappropriate' and 'insensitive' email about the Hillsborough disaster. A police chief has been forced to apologize after sending an email that accused families of those killed in the Hillsborough disaster of lying. David Crompton, Chief Constable of South Yorkshire Police, issued a full apology for the email, sent just before the publication of a report in September criticizing police handling of the incident that led to the deaths of 96 Liverpool fans at Sheffield Wednesday’s stadium in 1989. The email discussed the launch of a website presenting South Yorkshire Police’s version of events surrounding the disaster. Mr. Crompton mentioned republishing past apologies from previous chief constables and keeping the site 'purely factual.' It was addressed to Assistant Chief Constable Andy Holt and the force’s head of corporate communications, Mark Thompson. The email read: 'One thing is certain — the Hillsborough Campaign for Justice will be doing their version... in fact, their version of certain events has become 'the truth,' even though it isn’t! I just have a feeling that the media machine favors the families and not us, so we need to be a bit more innovative in our response to have a fighting chance, otherwise we will just be roadkill.' Mr. Crompton apologized for his remarks, stating the email was sent prior to the release of the Hillsborough Independent Panel report. He said: 'The email from last September was written before the release of the Hillsborough Independent Panel Report. It was never intended to cause any offense, and I apologize if it has done so. Nor was it intended to challenge the integrity or views of those who lost loved ones in the Hillsborough Disaster.' Shaun Wright, Police and Crime Commissioner for South Yorkshire, said: 'I was disappointed by the use of such language, even in an internal email, and raised my concerns with the Chief Constable. As Police and Crime Commissioner, it is my duty to hold the Chief Constable and the Force accountable in the public interest. I accept the Chief Constable’s regret for his language in this specific email and his apology.' Mr. Wright added that he has informed the Independent Police Complaints Commission and the Home Secretary about the email. Tragically, 96 Liverpool fans died during the opening minutes of the FA Cup Semi-Final between Liverpool and Nottingham Forest on April 15, 1989. Details of the email emerged following a Freedom of Information request. The Hillsborough Independent Panel concluded that no Liverpool fan was responsible for the tragedy, placing blame squarely on a 'failure of police control.' Tributes to the victims were left in their thousands at memorials across the UK.

article_content: A groundbreaking 2012 study has shattered long-standing assumptions about malaria, revealing the disease kills nearly twice as many people worldwide as previously believed. Contrary to the widely held view that malaria primarily claims the lives of children under five, new data shows that more than 40% of victims are older children and adults. Led by Dr. Christopher Murray of the University of Washington’s Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation, researchers analyzed global mortality data from 1980 to 2010 and found 1.2 million malaria-related deaths in 2010 alone — almost double the figure reported by the World Health Organization the previous year. The disparity was especially stark in Africa: deaths among children over five and adults were estimated to be 8.1 times higher than WHO numbers suggested. Outside Africa, the gap was still significant, with 1.8 times more deaths than previously accounted for. In total, 433,000 more people over the age of five died from malaria than official estimates indicated. Dr. Murray challenged the medical community’s traditional belief that exposure to malaria in childhood leads to lifelong immunity. ‘What we’ve seen in hospital records, death certificates, and population surveys tells a different story,’ he said. ‘Adults are dying from this disease far more often than anyone realized.’ But there’s also encouraging news: after hitting a peak of 1.8 million deaths in 2004, global malaria fatalities have dropped every year since. Between 2007 and 2010, the decline exceeded 7% annually — a trend researchers attribute to massive increases in funding and coordinated action by global health partners like the Global Fund. Co-author Dr. Alan Lopez emphasized the importance of accurate data: ‘We can’t effectively fight what we don’t measure properly. These revised numbers aren’t just statistics — they’re a call to action.’ While the progress is real, the study warns that eliminating malaria deaths by 2015 is no longer feasible. If current trends hold, the global death toll won’t fall below 100,000 until after 2020 — underscoring the urgent need for sustained investment and smarter targeting of resources across all age groups and regions.

Condus de dr. Disparitatea a fost deosebit de mare în Africa: decesele dintre copiii peste cinci ani și adulți au fost estimate la 8,1 ori mai multe decât cifrele OMS. În afara Africii, diferența a fost tot semnificativă, cu 1,8 ori mai multe decese decât a fost luat în calcul anterior. În total, 433.000 de persoane peste vârsta de cinci ani au murit din cauza malariei, cu mult mai mult decât estimațiile oficiale indicau. Dr. Murray a contestat credința tradițională a comunității medicale conform căreia expunerea la malaria în copilărie duce la imunitate pe viață. „Ceea ce am văzut în registrele spitalelor, actele de deces și sondajele populației ne spune o altă poveste,” a spus el. „Adulții mor din cauza acestei boli mult mai des decât oricine și-a imaginat.” Dar există și știri încurajatoare: după ce a atins un vârf de 1,8 milioane de decese în 2004, numărul de decese globale datorate malariei a scăzut an de an. Între 2007 și 2010, scăderea a depășit 7% anual — o tendință pe care cercetătorii o atribuie creșterii masive a finanțărilor și acțiunilor coordonate ale partenerilor internaționali de sănătate, cum ar fi Fondul Global. article_content: On the early morning of Friday, October 25, 2013, 46-year-old Edward Scott Russ entered a CVS pharmacy in Belmont, North Carolina, armed with an assault rifle, allegedly intending to rob the store. Before he could make any demands, a customer noticed the threat and immediately called 911. Police arrived within minutes and ordered Russ to drop his weapon—he instead fired shots from 15 to 20 feet away, narrowly missing officers. Law enforcement returned fire but did not strike him, then withdrew upon learning hostages were inside. Russ held three employees—two men and one woman—for nearly five hours. During the standoff, he instructed one hostage to warn police that a life would be lost if they didn’t leave the area. Surveillance footage showed him taking pills from the pharmacy, raising concerns about suicidal intentions. A negotiator maintained phone contact while multiple agencies, including SWAT, secured the perimeter. Around 4 a.m., Russ released the final hostage unharmed. Moments later, he placed his rifle on a counter, stepped outside with his hands raised, and said, 'I’m sorry.' No one was injured. Russ was arrested and is currently held at Gaston County Jail on a $5 million bond, facing charges including three counts of first-degree kidnapping, two counts of assault on an officer with a firearm, two counts of attempted murder, robbery with a dangerous weapon, and communicating threats. His first court appearance is set for Monday. Belmont lies approximately 15 miles west of Charlotte.

Înainte de a putea face vreo cerere, un client a observat amenințarea și a sunat imediat la 911. Polițiștii au ajuns în câteva minute și i-au ordonat lui Russ să depună arma — el a deschis focul dintr-o distanță de 15 până la 20 de metri, evitând în mod îngust să lovească oficialii. Russ a fost arestat și este ținut în centrul de detenție din județul Gaston, cu o cauțiune de 5 milioane de dolari, acuzat de trei infracțiuni de răpire în primul grad, două infracțiuni de agresiune asupra unui ofițer cu armă de foc, două infracțiuni de încercare de omucidere, furt cu armă periculoasă și amenințări. Prima sa apariție în fața instanței este programată pentru luni. Belmont se află la aproximativ 15 mile vest de Charlotte.

article_content: Pol Espargaro, a Spanish MotoGP rider for Yamaha Tech 3, suffered a broken bone in his left foot after a violent crash during a practice session ahead of the Malaysian Grand Prix at Sepang on Saturday. The crash occurred when a piece of glass punctured the radiator on his bike, causing it to catch fire. Espargaro was thrown from the machine at Turn 1, despite another rider attempting to warn him of the issue. He was immediately withdrawn from Practice 4 and qualifying due to his injury. Emergency crews quickly extinguished the flames on his bike. Espargaro is expected to undergo a medical assessment on Sunday morning to determine if he can compete in the race. Meanwhile, newly crowned MotoGP world champion Marc Marquez claimed his 13th pole position of the season at Sepang, setting a new lap record of 1:59.791 — nearly two-tenths of a second faster than his Honda teammate Dani Pedrosa.
